quote: When a large feedforward neural network is trained on a small training set, it typically performs poorly on held-out test data.
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：当大型前馈神经网络在小训练集上训练时，通常在留出测试数据上表现很差，即过拟合 [p1]。

quote: If the relationship between the input and the correct output is complicated and the network has enough hidden units to model it accurately, there will typically be many different settings of the weights that can model the training set almost perfectly, especially if there is only a limited amount of labeled training data.
claim: 原文指出，如果输入与正确输出之间的关系复杂且网络有足够多的隐藏单元，通常会有许多不同的权重设置能几乎完美地建模训练集，尤其是当标注训练数据有限时 [p2]。

quote: On each presentation of each training case, each hidden unit is randomly omitted from the network with a probability of 0.5, so a hidden unit cannot rely on other hidden units being present.
claim: 论文提出用 dropout 来减少过拟合：在每次呈现每个训练样本时，每个隐藏单元以 0.5 的概率被随机从网络中省略，从而使隐藏单元不能依赖其他隐藏单元的存在 [p3]。

quote: On each presentation of each training case, each hidden unit is randomly omitted from the network with a probability of 0.5, so a hidden unit cannot rely on other hidden units being present.
claim: 作者将 dropout 视为一种非常高效的神经网络模型平均方式，可以在合理时间内训练大量不同的网络，而这些网络共享被保留隐藏单元的相同权重 [p3]。

quote: Instead of penalizing the squared length (L2 norm) of the whole weight vector, we set an upper bound on the L2 norm of the incoming weight vector for each individual hidden unit.
claim: 训练使用标准随机梯度下降，但将通常的权重惩罚改为对每个隐藏单元输入权重向量的 L2 范数设置上界，若权重更新违反该约束则通过除法重新归一化 [p4]。

quote: It contains 60,000 28x28 training images of individual hand written digits and 10,000 test images.
claim: 论文在多个基准任务上验证 dropout：MNIST 手写数字数据集（60,000 张 28x28 训练图像和 10,000 张测试图像）[p6]；

quote: The input to the net is 21 adjacent frames with an advance of 10ms per frame.
claim: TIMIT 语音基准的核心测试集，输入为 21 个相邻帧、每帧间隔 10ms，网络有 4 个全连接隐藏层、每层 4000 个单元和 185 个 softmax 输出单元 [p9]；

quote: It uses 32x32 downsampled color images of 10 different object classes
claim: CIFAR-10 物体识别基准（32x32 下采样彩色图像，50,000 训练和 10,000 测试图像）[p10]；

quote: In 2010, a subset of 1000 classes with roughly 1000 examples per class was the basis of an object recognition competition
claim: 以及 ImageNet 物体识别数据集（2010 年竞赛子集，约 1000 类、每类约 1000 例）[p11]。

quote: We trained a neural network using dropout-backpropagation and compared it with standard backpropagation.
claim: 此外还在 Reuters 数据集上进行了实验 [A3.p3]。

quote: Without using any of these tricks, the best published result for a standard feedforward neural network is 160 errors on the test set.
claim: 在 MNIST 上，不使用任何技巧时标准前馈神经网络的最佳已发表结果为 160 个测试错误，使用 50% dropout 并配合每个隐藏单元输入权重的独立 L2 约束可降至约 130 个错误，再随机丢弃 20% 像素可进一步降至约 110 个错误 [p6]。

quote: Without dropout, the recognition rate is $22.7$ % and with dropout this improves to $19.7$ %, which is a record for methods that do not use any information about speaker identity.
claim: 在 TIMIT 上，无 dropout 时识别率为 22.7%，使用 dropout 后改善至 19.7%，这是不使用说话人身份信息的方法中的纪录 [p9]。

quote: The best published error rate on the test set, without using transformed data, is 18.5%. We achieved an error rate of 16.6%
claim: 在 CIFAR-10 上，不使用变换数据的最佳已发表错误率为 18.5%，作者用卷积网络达到 16.6%，在最后一个隐藏层使用 dropout 后达到 15.6% [p10]。

quote: We achieved comparable performance of 48.6% error using a single neural network
claim: 在 ImageNet 上，作者用单个神经网络达到 48.6% 错误率，在第六隐藏层使用 50% dropout 后降至创纪录的 42.4% [p11]。

quote: The publically available, pre-trained deep belief net described in got 118 errors when it was fine-tuned using standard back-propagation and 92 errors when fine-tuned using 50% dropout of the hidden units.
claim: 此外，dropout 与生成式预训练结合时，预训练深度信念网用标准反向传播微调得到 118 个错误，用 50% dropout 微调得到 92 个错误 [p7]。

quote: Is learning better networks as easy as stacking more layers?
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：随着网络加深，训练误差反而升高（退化问题），而这一问题并非由梯度消失/爆炸导致 [S1.p2][S1.p5]。

quote: In this paper, we address the degradation problem by introducing a deep residual learning framework.
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：随着网络加深，训练误差反而升高（退化问题），而这一问题并非由梯度消失/爆炸导致 [S1.p2][S1.p5]。

quote: Recent evidence reveals that network depth is of crucial importance
claim: 作者指出深度对图像分类至关重要，但简单堆叠更多层并不一定更容易学到更好的网络 [S1.p1][S1.p2]。

quote: Is learning better networks as easy as stacking more layers?
claim: 作者指出深度对图像分类至关重要，但简单堆叠更多层并不一定更容易学到更好的网络 [S1.p1][S1.p2]。

quote: we explicitly let these layers fit a residual mapping
claim: 论文提出残差学习框架：不要求堆叠层直接拟合目标映射 H(x)，而是让它们拟合残差映射 F(x):=H(x)-x，原始映射变为 F(x)+x [S1.p5]。

quote: we explicitly let these layers fit a residual mapping
claim: 作者假设优化残差映射比优化原始无参考映射更容易，极端情况下若恒等映射最优，将残差推向零比用非线性层拟合恒等映射更容易 [S1.p5]。

quote: We adopt batch normalization (BN) right after each convolution and before activation
claim: 在实现上，ImageNet 模型采用批归一化、SGD、mini-batch 256、学习率从 0.1 开始并在误差平台时除以 10 等设置 [S3.SS4.p1]。

quote: We evaluate our method on the ImageNet 2012 classification dataset that consists of 1000 classes.
claim: 论文在 ImageNet 2012 分类数据集上评估，该数据集包含 1000 类、128 万训练图像、5 万验证图像和 10 万测试图像，报告 top-1 和 top-5 错误率 [S4.SS1.p1]。

quote: We conducted more studies on the CIFAR-10 dataset, which consists of 50k training images and 10k testing images in 10 classes.
claim: 作者还使用 CIFAR-10 数据集（5 万训练图像、1 万测试图像、10 类）研究极深网络行为 [S4.SS2.p1]。

quote: We adopt Faster R-CNN as the detection method.
claim: 此外，论文在 PASCAL VOC 2007/2012 和 MS COCO 上采用 Faster R-CNN 进行目标检测评估，比较用 ResNet-101 替换 VGG-16 的改进 [S4.SS3.p1]。

quote: the 34-layer ResNet is better than the 18-layer ResNet (by 2.8%)
claim: 在 ImageNet 上，34 层 ResNet 比 18 层 ResNet 好 2.8%，且 34 层 ResNet 比对应的普通网络降低 top-1 错误率 3.5% [S4.SS1.p6][S4.SS1.p7]。

quote: the 34-layer ResNet reduces the top-1 error by 3.5%
claim: 在 ImageNet 上，34 层 ResNet 比 18 层 ResNet 好 2.8%，且 34 层 ResNet 比对应的普通网络降低 top-1 错误率 3.5% [S4.SS1.p6][S4.SS1.p7]。

quote: The 50/101/152-layer ResNets are more accurate than the 34-layer ones by considerable margins
claim: 50/101/152 层 ResNet 比 34 层更准确，未观察到退化问题，并从深度增加中获得显著精度提升 [S4.SS1.p15]。

quote: Our 152-layer ResNet has a single-model top-5 validation error of 4.49%.
claim: 152 层 ResNet 单模型 top-5 验证错误率为 4.49%，超过此前所有集成结果；六模型集成在测试集上达到 3.57% top-5 错误率，赢得 ILSVRC 2015 第一名 [S4.SS1.p16]。

quote: our ResNets manage to overcome the optimization difficulty and demonstrate accuracy gains when the depth increases
claim: 在 CIFAR-10 上，ResNet 同样克服优化困难并在深度增加时获得精度提升 [S4.SS2.p5]。

quote: we obtain a 6.0% increase in COCO’s standard metric (mAP@[.5,.95]), which is a 28% relative improvement
claim: 在 COCO 检测上，ResNet-101 相比 VGG-16 在 mAP@[.5,.95] 上提升 6.0%，相对提升 28% [S4.SS3.p1]。

quote: The testing result of this 1202-layer network is worse than that of our 110-layer network, although both have similar training error.
claim: 作者指出，1202 层网络在 CIFAR-10 上的测试结果比 110 层网络更差，尽管两者训练误差相近，作者认为这是因为过拟合，且该网络对此小数据集可能过大 [S4.SS2.p9]。

quote: The testing result of this 1202-layer network is worse than that of our 110-layer network, although both have similar training error.
claim: 作者在 CIFAR-10 上未使用 maxout/dropout，仅通过深而窄的架构施加正则化，并指出结合更强正则化可能改善结果，留待未来研究 [S4.SS2.p9]。

quote: The reason for such optimization difficulties will be studied in the future.
claim: 对于深层普通网络优化困难的原因，作者表示将在未来研究 [S4.SS1.p4]。

quote: This inherently sequential nature precludes parallelization within training examples, which becomes critical at longer sequence lengths
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：主流序列转换模型依赖复杂的循环或卷积神经网络，其固有的顺序计算特性阻碍了训练样本内部的并行化，在序列较长时尤为关键 [S1.p2]。

quote: In all but a few cases, however, such attention mechanisms are used in conjunction with a recurrent network.
claim: 作者指出，注意力机制虽已被广泛使用，但几乎总是与循环网络结合使用 [S1.p3]。

quote: In this work we propose the Transformer, a model architecture eschewing recurrence and instead relying entirely on an attention mechanism to draw global dependencies between input and output.
claim: 因此本文提出 Transformer，完全依靠注意力机制来建立输入与输出之间的全局依赖，从而允许显著更多的并行化 [S1.p4]。

quote: The Transformer follows this overall architecture using stacked self-attention and point-wise, fully connected layers for both the encoder and decoder
claim: Transformer 采用堆叠的自注意力层与逐位置全连接层构成编码器和解码器 [S3.p2]。

quote: An attention function can be described as mapping a query and a set of key-value pairs to an output
claim: 其核心注意力函数将查询与一组键值对映射为输出，输出是值的加权和，权重由查询与对应键的兼容性函数计算 [S3.SS2.p1]。

quote: We compute the dot products of the query with all keys, divide each by $\sqrt{d_{k}}$, and apply a softmax function to obtain the weights on the values.
claim: 作者提出缩放点积注意力：计算查询与所有键的点积，各除以 √dk 后经 softmax 得到值的权重 [S3.SS2.SSS1.p1]。

quote: we found it beneficial to linearly project the queries, keys and values $h$ times with different, learned linear projections
claim: 此外使用多头注意力，将查询、键、值线性投影 h 次后并行执行注意力，再拼接并投影 [S3.SS2.SSS2.p1]；

quote: In this work we employ $h=8$ parallel attention layers, or heads.
claim: 本文采用 h=8 个并行注意力头，每个头 dk=dv=dmodel/h=64 [S3.SS2.SSS2.p5]。

quote: We trained on the standard WMT 2014 English-German dataset consisting of about 4.5 million sentence pairs.
claim: 训练数据为标准的 WMT 2014 英德数据集，约 450 万句对，使用字节对编码，共享源-目标词表约 37000 个 token；英法使用更大的 WMT 2014 英法数据集，含 3600 万句，词表为 32000 个 word-piece [S5.SS1.p1]。

quote: we varied our base model in different ways, measuring the change in performance on English-to-German translation on the development set, newstest2013
claim: 为评估各组件重要性，作者在英德翻译的开发集 newstest2013 上对基础模型做多种变体，使用束搜索但不做检查点平均 [S6.SS2.p1]。

quote: We used a beam size of $21$ and $\alpha=0.3$ for both WSJ only and the semi-supervised setting.
claim: 在英语成分句法分析上，作者仅在 Section 22 开发集上少量实验选择 dropout、学习率和束大小，其余参数保持英德基础翻译模型不变，推理时束大小为 21、α=0.3 [S6.SS3.p3]。

quote: Our model achieves 28.4 BLEU on the WMT 2014 English-to-German translation task, improving over the existing best results, including ensembles, by over 2 BLEU.
claim: 在 WMT 2014 英德翻译任务上，模型取得 28.4 BLEU，超过包括集成模型在内的现有最佳结果 2 BLEU 以上 [abstract]。

quote: Our model achieves 28.4 BLEU on the WMT 2014 English-to-German translation task, improving over the existing best results, including ensembles, by over 2 BLEU.
claim: 在英法任务上，模型以 8 块 GPU 训练 3.5 天后取得 41.8 的单模型 BLEU，训练成本仅为文献中最佳模型的一小部分 [abstract]。

quote: While single-head attention is 0.9 BLEU worse than the best setting, quality also drops off with too many heads.
claim: 在模型变体中，单头注意力比最佳设置差 0.9 BLEU，头数过多时质量也会下降 [S6.SS2.p2]。

quote: yielding better results than all previously reported models with the exception of the Recurrent Neural Network Grammar
claim: 在英语成分句法分析上，尽管缺乏任务特定调参，模型表现仍优于此前所有报告模型，仅不及 Recurrent Neural Network Grammar [S6.SS3.p4]。

quote: a self-attention layer connects all positions with a constant number of sequentially executed operations, whereas a recurrent layer requires $O(n)$ sequential operations
claim: 此外，自注意力层以常数个顺序执行操作连接所有位置，而循环层需要 O(n) 个顺序操作 [S4.p4]。

quote: In the Transformer this is reduced to a constant number of operations, albeit at the cost of reduced effective resolution due to averaging attention-weighted positions
claim: 作者指出，将任意两个位置关联所需的操作数在 Transformer 中降为常数，但代价是有效分辨率降低，原因是注意力加权位置被平均，这一影响通过多头注意力来抵消 [S2.p1]。

quote: To improve computational performance for tasks involving very long sequences, self-attention could be restricted to considering only a neighborhood of size $r$
claim: 作者还提出，为提升极长序列任务的计算性能，可将自注意力限制为只考虑以输出位置为中心、大小为 r 的邻域，并计划在未来工作中进一步研究该做法 [S4.p4]。

quote: However, their ability to access and precisely manipulate knowledge is still limited, and hence on knowledge-intensive tasks, their performance lags behind task-specific architectures.
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：预训练语言模型虽能存储事实知识，但访问和精确操作知识的能力有限，在知识密集型任务上落后于任务专用架构，且难以提供决策依据和更新世界知识 [abstract]。

quote: REALM and ORQA, two recently introduced models that combine masked language models with a differentiable retriever, have shown promising results, but have only explored open-domain extractive question answering.
claim: 作者希望将混合参数与非参数记忆的方法从抽取式任务扩展到序列到序列生成模型 [S1.p1]。

quote: We explore RAG models, which use the input sequence $x$ to retrieve text documents $z$ and use them as additional context when generating the target sequence $y$.
claim: RAG 使用输入序列检索文本文档，并将其作为生成目标序列的额外上下文 [S2.p1]。

quote: We explore RAG models, which use the input sequence $x$ to retrieve text documents $z$ and use them as additional context when generating the target sequence $y$.
claim: 模型包含检索器 p_η(z|x)（基于 DPR 的双编码器）和生成器 p_θ（BART），将检索文档视为隐变量并端到端训练 [S2.p1][S2.p2][S2.SS2.p1]。

quote: To train the retriever and generator end-to-end, we treat the retrieved document as a latent variable.
claim: 模型包含检索器 p_η(z|x)（基于 DPR 的双编码器）和生成器 p_θ（BART），将检索文档视为隐变量并端到端训练 [S2.p1][S2.p2][S2.SS2.p1]。

quote: The retrieval component $p_{\eta}(z|x)$ is based on DPR. DPR follows a bi-encoder architecture
claim: 模型包含检索器 p_η(z|x)（基于 DPR 的双编码器）和生成器 p_θ（BART），将检索文档视为隐变量并端到端训练 [S2.p1][S2.p2][S2.SS2.p1]。

quote: To train the retriever and generator end-to-end, we treat the retrieved document as a latent variable.
claim: 作者提出两种边缘化方式：RAG-Sequence 对整条输出使用同一文档，RAG-Token 可为每个 token 使用不同文档 [S2.p2]。

quote: For all experiments, we use a single Wikipedia dump for our non-parametric knowledge source.
claim: 实验使用 2018 年 12 月的 Wikipedia dump 作为非参数知识源，每篇文章切分为 100 词的不重叠块，共 2100 万文档，并用 FAISS 构建 MIPS 索引 [S3.p1]。

quote: For all experiments, we use a single Wikipedia dump for our non-parametric knowledge source.
claim: 训练时检索 top k 文档，k 取 5 或 10，测试时的 k 由开发集确定 [S3.p1]。

quote: We consider four popular open-domain QA datasets: Natural Questions (NQ), TriviaQA (TQA). WebQuestions (WQ) and CuratedTrec (CT).
claim: 评估覆盖开放域问答（NQ、TriviaQA、WebQuestions、CuratedTrec）、抽象问答（MSMARCO NLG）、Jeopardy 问题生成和 FEVER 事实验证等任务 [S3.SS1.p1][S3.SS2.p1][S3.SS3.p1][S1.p4]。

quote: To test RAG’s natural language generation (NLG) in a knowledge-intensive setting, we use the MSMARCO NLG task v2.1.
claim: 评估覆盖开放域问答（NQ、TriviaQA、WebQuestions、CuratedTrec）、抽象问答（MSMARCO NLG）、Jeopardy 问题生成和 FEVER 事实验证等任务 [S3.SS1.p1][S3.SS2.p1][S3.SS3.p1][S1.p4]。

quote: To evaluate RAG’s generation abilities in a non-QA setting, we study open-domain question generation.
claim: 评估覆盖开放域问答（NQ、TriviaQA、WebQuestions、CuratedTrec）、抽象问答（MSMARCO NLG）、Jeopardy 问题生成和 FEVER 事实验证等任务 [S3.SS1.p1][S3.SS2.p1][S3.SS3.p1][S1.p4]。

quote: For FEVER fact verification, we achieve results within 4.3% of state-of-the-art pipeline models which use strong retrieval supervision.
claim: 评估覆盖开放域问答（NQ、TriviaQA、WebQuestions、CuratedTrec）、抽象问答（MSMARCO NLG）、Jeopardy 问题生成和 FEVER 事实验证等任务 [S3.SS1.p1][S3.SS2.p1][S3.SS3.p1][S1.p4]。

quote: On all four open-domain QA tasks, RAG sets a new state of the art (only on the T5-comparable split for TQA).
claim: 在四个开放域问答任务上，RAG 均取得新的最优结果（TriviaQA 仅在 T5 可比划分上）[S4.SS1.p1]。

quote: On all four open-domain QA tasks, RAG sets a new state of the art (only on the T5-comparable split for TQA).
claim: RAG 无需昂贵的专门预训练即可获得强结果，且表明重排序器和抽取式阅读器并非最优性能所必需 [S4.SS1.p1]。

quote: RAG-Sequence outperforms BART on Open MS-MARCO NLG by 2.6 Bleu points and 2.6 Rouge-L points.
claim: 在 MS-MARCO NLG 上，RAG-Sequence 比 BART 高 2.6 BLEU 和 2.6 Rouge-L [S4.SS2.p1]。

quote: RAG-Token performs better than RAG-Sequence on Jeopardy question generation, with both models outperforming BART on Q-BLEU-1.
claim: 在 Jeopardy 问题生成上，RAG-Token 优于 RAG-Sequence，两者均超过 BART 的 Q-BLEU-1 [S4.SS3.p1]。

quote: RAG-Token performs better than RAG-Sequence on Jeopardy question generation, with both models outperforming BART on Q-BLEU-1.
claim: 人工评估中，BART 仅在 7.1% 的情况下比 RAG 更符合事实，而 RAG 在 42.7% 的情况下更符合事实 [S4.SS3.p1]。

quote: In preliminary experiments, we observed that for some tasks such as story generation, the retrieval component would “collapse” and learn to retrieve the same documents regardless of the input.
claim: 作者在初步实验中发现，对于故事生成等任务，检索组件会“崩溃”，无论输入如何都检索相同文档；此时生成器学会忽略文档，RAG 表现与 BART 相当 [A8.p1]。

quote: In preliminary experiments, we observed that for some tasks such as story generation, the retrieval component would “collapse” and learn to retrieve the same documents regardless of the input.
claim: 作者推测这种崩溃可能源于某些任务对事实知识需求不够明确，或目标序列较长导致检索器梯度信息不足 [A8.p1]。

quote: In future work, it may be fruitful to investigate if the two components can be jointly pre-trained from scratch
claim: 此外，作者指出未来工作可研究两个组件能否从头联合预训练 [S6.p1]。

quote: there is still a need for task-specific datasets and task-specific fine-tuning

quote: the need for a large dataset of labeled examples for every new task limits the applicability of language models

quote: humans do not require large supervised datasets to learn most language tasks
claim: 作者认为去除这一限制是可取的，因为许多有用任务难以收集大规模监督训练数据，且人类通常只需简短指令或极少示例即可完成新语言任务 [S1.p3][S1.p5]。

quote: We group the datasets into 9 categories representing roughly similar tasks.
claim: 数据集被分为 9 个类别，涵盖语言建模、闭卷问答、翻译、Winograd 式任务、常识推理、阅读理解、SuperGLUE、NLI 以及合成与定性任务 [S3.p2][S3.p3]。

quote: we evaluate each example in the evaluation set by randomly drawing $K$ examples from that task’s training set as conditioning

claim: 少样本评估时从任务训练集中随机抽取 K 个示例作为条件，K 通常为 10 到 100，受模型上下文窗口 n_ctx=2048 限制 [S2.SS4.p1][S2.SS4.p2]。

quote: Final results are reported on the test set when publicly available, for each model size and learning setting
claim: 结果在公开测试集上报告，测试集私有时则报告开发集结果 [S2.SS4.p6]。

quote: GPT-3 achieves strong performance on many NLP datasets, including translation, question-answering, and cloze tasks
claim: GPT-3 在多个 NLP 数据集上取得较强表现，包括翻译、问答和完形填空，以及需要即时推理或领域适应的任务 [abstract]。

quote: in a zero-shot setting GPT-3 achieves 76% on LAMBADA, a gain of 8% over the previous state of the art
claim: 在 LAMBADA 上，GPT-3 零样本达到 76%，比此前最先进结果提升 8%；少样本达到 86.4%，比此前最先进结果提升超过 18% [S3.SS1.SSS2.p1][S3.SS1.SSS2.p5]。

claim: 在 LAMBADA 上，GPT-3 零样本达到 76%，比此前最先进结果提升 8%；少样本达到 86.4%，比此前最先进结果提升超过 18% [S3.SS1.SSS2.p1][S3.SS1.SSS2.p5]。

quote: On TriviaQA, we achieve 64.3% in the zero-shot setting, 68.0% in the one-shot setting, and 71.2% in the few-shot setting.
claim: 在 TriviaQA 上，零样本 64.3%、单样本 68.0%、少样本 71.2%，其中零样本已超过微调的 T5-11B 14.2% [S3.SS2.p2]。

quote: GPT-3 175B achieves 85 F1 in the few-shot setting, only a few points behind measured human performance and state-of-the-art fine-tuned models.

quote: our experiments do not include any bidirectional architectures or other training objectives such as denoising

quote: scaling pure self-supervised prediction is likely to hit limits, and augmentation with a different approach is likely to be necessary

quote: it still sees much more text during pre-training than a human sees in the their lifetime

quote: ambiguity about whether few-shot learning actually learns new tasks “from scratch” at inference time, or if it simply recognizes and identifies tasks that it has learned during training

claim: 论文采用受控的合成数据集方法，构建了包含 10 万个人物传记的 bioS 数据集，并用 Llama 生成接近真实风格的 bioR 数据集 [S2.p1][S2.p4]。

quote: After pretraining the model on the entire biography, we fine-tune it using question and answer (QA) pairs from a $p$ fraction of individuals. We then test its ability to out-of-distribution answer QAs about the remaining $1-p$ fraction.

quote: We propose two probing methods: position-based (P-probing) and query-based (Q-probing). Both methods employ simple, nearly-linear probes to extract personal attributes from the model’s hidden states.

quote: In both of the validation regions, with no entanglement signal, the measurements are found to agree with the predictions from different MC setups within the uncertainties.

quote: learning cooccurrence statistics in either domain recovers roughly the same perceptual representation
claim: 颜色案例研究表明，从图像或文本共现统计中学习都能恢复大致相同的感知表示 [S4.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

quote: different sensors and views might capture different information, which may limit their potential to converge to identical representations
claim: 作者承认，不同传感器和视角可能捕获不同信息，这可能限制它们收敛到完全相同的表示 [S1.p4]。

quote: Our argument has mainly focused on two modalities: vision and language.
claim: 作者指出，当前论证主要聚焦视觉和语言两种模态，其他模态尚未看到同等程度的收敛，例如机器人领域还没有标准化的世界状态表示方式 [S6.SS0.SSS0.Px2.p1]。

quote: Two different models cannot converge to the same representation if they have access to fundamentally different information.
claim: 作者还指出，不同模态可能包含不同信息，两个模型如果访问根本不同的信息就无法收敛到同一表示，需要更精细的假说来处理非双射观测和抽象概念 [S6.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p1][S6.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p3]。

quote: A more nuanced version of our hypothesis will need to be developed to handle the case of non-bijective observations and abstract concepts.
claim: 作者还指出，不同模态可能包含不同信息，两个模型如果访问根本不同的信息就无法收敛到同一表示，需要更精细的假说来处理非双射观测和抽象概念 [S6.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p1][S6.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p3]。

quote: Our argument only holds for intelligences that are optimized to perform well on many tasks.
claim: 此外，作者承认其论证只适用于被优化以在多个任务上表现良好的智能系统，专用智能可能不会收敛 [S6.SS0.SSS0.Px4.p1]。

quote: We have shown results where different models arrive at similar but not the same representations.
claim: 作者还指出，不同模型到达的是相似但不相同的表示，例如图 3 中对齐分数仅达到 0.16，而该指标理论最大值为 1，这一差距是噪声还是重大差异仍未解决 [S6.SS0.SSS0.Px6.p1]。

quote: However, applying agents to more complex code tasks like software engineering remains unexplored.
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：如何为语言模型 agent 设计专门的接口，以提升其完成软件工程任务的能力 [S1.p1][S2.p1]。

quote: We argue that LM agents represent a new category of end user, with their own needs and abilities.
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：如何为语言模型 agent 设计专门的接口，以提升其完成软件工程任务的能力 [S1.p1][S2.p1]。

quote: However, applying agents to more complex code tasks like software engineering remains unexplored.
claim: 作者指出，将 agent 应用于软件工程等更复杂代码任务仍未被探索，而人类工程师能从 VSCode 等强大应用中受益，因此受 HCI 研究启发，探究 LM agent 是否也能从更好设计的接口中受益 [S1.p1]。

quote: SWE-agent, an agent composed of an LM and ACI, that can interact with a computer to solve challenging real-world software engineering problems
claim: 论文提出 SWE-agent，由 LM 和 ACI 组成，通过迭代生成 thought 和 command 并接收环境反馈来与计算机交互 [S1.p3][S3.p1]。

quote: The ACI comprises several principal components, including search/navigation, file viewer, file editor, and context management.
claim: 论文提出 SWE-agent，由 LM 和 ACI 组成，通过迭代生成 thought 和 command 并接收环境反馈来与计算机交互 [S1.p3][S3.p1]。

quote: SWE-agent, an agent composed of an LM and ACI, that can interact with a computer to solve challenging real-world software engineering problems
claim: 其 ACI 提供一小组简单动作用于查看、搜索和编辑文件，使用 guardrails 防止常见错误，并在每轮给出具体简洁的反馈 [S1.p3]。

quote: The ACI comprises several principal components, including search/navigation, file viewer, file editor, and context management.
claim: ACI 包含搜索/导航、文件查看器、文件编辑器和上下文管理等组件，并集成了代码 linter 以在编辑时提示错误 [S3.p1][S3.p5]。

quote: we integrate a code linter into the edit function to alert the agent of mistakes it may have introduced when editing a file.
claim: ACI 包含搜索/导航、文件查看器、文件编辑器和上下文管理等组件，并集成了代码 linter 以在编辑时提示错误 [S3.p1][S3.p5]。

quote: we assume a fixed LM and focus on designing the ACI to improve its performance.
claim: 作者假设 LM 固定，专注于设计 ACI，通过人工检查 agent 行为和网格搜索来选择最佳配置 [S2.p4]。

quote: We primarily evaluate on the SWE-bench dataset, which includes $2,294$ task instances from $12$ different repositories of popular Python packages.
claim: 论文主要在 SWE-bench 数据集上评估，该数据集包含来自 12 个流行 Python 包的 2,294 个任务实例；消融和分析在 SWE-bench Lite（300 个实例）上进行 [S4.p1]。

quote: We primarily evaluate on the SWE-bench dataset, which includes $2,294$ task instances from $12$ different repositories of popular Python packages.
claim: 此外还用 HumanEvalFix 测试基本的代码编辑能力 [S4.p1]。

quote: We benchmark models in the SWE-agent, Basic CLI, and Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) settings established in SWE-bench.
claim: 对比设置包括 SWE-agent、Basic CLI 和 Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) [S4.T3]。

quote: we performed a sweep over the window size, history processing, and decoding temperature
claim: 作者还进行了超参数扫描，包括窗口大小、历史处理和解码温度 [S4.p6]。

quote: SWE-agent solves $12.47$ % of the $2,294$ SWE-bench test tasks, substantially outperforming the previous best resolve rate of $3.8$ % by a non-interactive, retrieval-augmented system.
claim: 使用 GPT-4 Turbo 的 SWE-agent 解决了 12.47% 的 2,294 个 SWE-bench 测试任务，超过此前非交互式检索增强系统 3.8% 的最佳解决率 [S1.p4]。

quote: SWE-agent solves $12.47$ % of the $2,294$ SWE-bench test tasks, substantially outperforming the previous best resolve rate of $3.8$ % by a non-interactive, retrieval-augmented system.
claim: 在 SWE-bench Lite 上，SWE-agent 比仅使用默认 Linux shell 的基线 agent 多解决 10.7 个百分点 [S1.p4]。

quote: SWE-agent yields strong performance on HumanEvalFix with $88.3$ % pass@1 rate.
claim: SWE-agent 在 HumanEvalFix 上达到 88.3% 的 pass@1 [S5.p2]。

quote: Without SWE-agent’s file editor interface, performance drops to ( $10.3$ % $\downarrow$ 7.7).
claim: 消融实验表明，没有 SWE-agent 的文件编辑器接口时性能降至 10.3%（下降 7.7），文件查看器显示行数过少（30 行，下降 3.7）或过多（整个文件，下降 5.3）都会降低性能 [S5.SS1.p4]。

quote: Our main goal is to develop a rich body of theoretical connections between structured SSMs and variants of attention.
claim: 论文旨在建立结构化 SSM 与注意力变体之间丰富的理论联系，从而将原本为 Transformer 开发的算法与系统优化迁移到 SSM 上 [S1.p2]。

quote: the development of SSMs have appeared disjoint from the community’s collective effort to improve Transformers
claim: 原文指出，SSM 的发展与社区改进 Transformer 的集体努力显得脱节，导致 SSM 比 Transformer 更难理解和实验，且从算法和系统角度都难以像 Transformer 那样高效训练 [S1.p1]。

quote: Our framework connecting structured SSMs and variants of attention, which we call structured state space duality (SSD), is made through the abstractions of structured matrices
claim: 论文提出结构化状态空间对偶（SSD）框架，通过结构化矩阵（具有次二次参数和乘法复杂度的矩阵）这一抽象来连接结构化 SSM 与注意力变体 [S1.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

quote: Equation ( 3) directly establishes the link between state space models and the sequentially semiseparable representation
claim: 作者证明 SSM 等价于半可分矩阵，从而将 SSM 的高效计算问题归约为结构化矩阵乘法算法 [S3.SS3.p2][S3.SS4.p1]。

quote: it will allow us to reduce the problem of efficient computation of SSMs (and other sequence models) into efficient algorithms for structured matrix multiplication.
claim: 作者证明 SSM 等价于半可分矩阵，从而将 SSM 的高效计算问题归约为结构化矩阵乘法算法 [S3.SS3.p2][S3.SS4.p1]。

quote: we perform a block decomposition of the matrix. The diagonal blocks can be computed using the dual attention mode
claim: 在此基础上，作者提出基于半可分矩阵块分解的 SSD 算法，对角块用二次注意力模式计算，非对角块利用秩结构归约为更小的递推 [S6.p4]。

quote: We empirically evaluate Mamba-2 on synthetic recall tasks that have been challenging for recurrent models
claim: 作者在合成联想回忆任务（MQAR）上评估 Mamba-2，并在标准语言建模预训练与下游评估中与 Mamba、Transformer++ 及 Pythia 等模型比较 [S9.p1]。

quote: The model sizes (depth and width) follow GPT3 specifications, from 125m to 2.7B. We use the Pile dataset
claim: 语言建模实验使用 Pile 数据集，模型规模从 125M 到 2.7B，遵循 GPT3 规格，其中 2.7B 模型在 Pile 上训练 300B tokens [S9.SS2.p1][A4.SS3.p1]。

quote: we train Mamba-2 on 300B tokens on the Pile, using the GPT-NeoX tokenizer.
claim: 语言建模实验使用 Pile 数据集，模型规模从 125M 到 2.7B，遵循 GPT3 规格，其中 2.7B 模型在 Pile 上训练 300B tokens [S9.SS2.p1][A4.SS3.p1]。

quote: We benchmark the speed of the SSD algorithm against Mamba’s scan implementation and FlashAttention-2
claim: 作者还基准测试了 SSD 算法相对 Mamba 扫描实现和 FlashAttention-2 的速度 [S9.SS3.p1]。

quote: it is 2-8 $\times$ faster than Mamba’s fused associative scan
claim: SSD 算法比 Mamba 的融合扫描实现快 2-8 倍，且由于序列长度的线性缩放，从序列长度 2K 起快于 FlashAttention-2 [S9.SS3.p1]。

quote: Mamba-2 is Pareto dominant on performance (perplexity), theoretical FLOPs, and actual wall-clock time.
claim: 在缩放定律实验中，Mamba-2 在困惑度、理论 FLOPs 和实际墙钟时间上 Pareto 支配 Mamba 与 Transformer++ [S9.F9]。

quote: For each model size, Mamba-2 outperforms Mamba, and generally matches Pythia at twice the model size.
claim: 在零样本评估中，每种模型规模下 Mamba-2 均优于 Mamba，并大致匹配两倍模型规模的 Pythia [S9.T1]。

quote: While Mamba-1 struggles on this task, Mamba-2 performs well across all settings.
claim: 在 MQAR 任务上，Mamba-1 表现挣扎而 Mamba-2 在所有设置下表现良好，且增大状态规模持续提升性能 [S9.SS1.p3]。

quote: the main restriction of SSD is on the expressivity of the state transitions $A_{t}$.
claim: 作者指出，相比此前的结构化 SSM，SSD 的主要限制在于状态转移 $A_t$ 的表达能力，SSD 仅使用比 Mamba 稍更受限的对角 $A_t$ 形式，以表达能力换取硬件效率与实现便利 [S10.SS1.SSS0.Px3.p1]。

quote: the Mamba-2 model as a whole might not be as efficient to train as Transformer at short sequence length (e.g. at $2K$)
claim: 作者还指出，Mamba-2 整体在短序列长度（如 2K）下训练效率可能不如 Transformer，因为相同参数量下 Mamba-2 有 L 个 SSD 层而 Transformer 有 L/2 个 MLP 层和 L/2 个注意力层 [S9.SS3.p2]。

quote: SSD does not generalize standard softmax attention, or any other transformation on the attention kernel matrix that does not have a finite feature map $\psi$.
claim: 此外，作者强调 SSD 并不泛化标准 softmax 注意力或任何没有有限特征映射的注意力核变换 [S10.SS3.p8]。

quote: Generating novel active molecules for a given protein is an extremely challenging task for generative models that requires an understanding of the complex physical interactions between the molecule and its environment.
claim: 论文旨在解决给定蛋白质生成具有活性的新型 3D 分子这一挑战，该任务要求理解分子与环境之间复杂的物理相互作用 [abstract]。

quote: However, it’s noteworthy that most spatial molecular generators focus exclusively on atom types and locations.
claim: 现有大多数空间分子生成器仅关注原子类型和位置，依赖 OpenBabel 等外部工具进行键重建，而原子位置的微小调整可能显著改变重建的分子键甚至使分子图断开 [S1.p2]。

quote: However, the challenge of 3D molecule generation has received limited attention in language model approach.
claim: 此外，3D 分子生成在语言模型方法中受到的关注有限 [S2.p5]。

quote: The main principle in our approach is to formulate several 3D molecular design task as prompted generation of text.
claim: BindGPT 的核心思想是将多种 3D 小分子生成任务统一表述为带提示的文本生成，把条件 token 放在待生成对象 token 之前 [S3.p1]。

quote: we follow the decoder-only paradigm in Language Models and use the GPT-NeoX
claim: 模型采用 decoder-only 的 GPT-NeoX 架构，使用旋转位置嵌入以支持长度泛化 [S3.SS1.p1]。

quote: It uses structural SMILES and spatial XYZ formats to describe molecular graphs and atom locations, eliminating the dependency on external software for graph reconstruction.
claim: 它使用结构 SMILES 和空间 XYZ 格式描述分子图与原子位置，从而消除对外部图重建软件的依赖 [S1.p5]。

quote: During the supervised fine-tuning phase, we continue model training on CrossDocked 2020
claim: 训练流程包括大规模预训练、在 CrossDocked 2020 上的监督微调，以及使用 REINFORCE 算法和外部对接软件奖励的强化学习微调 [S3.SS3.SSS1.p1][S3.SS3.SSS2.p2]。

quote: We apply the REINFORCE algorithm for further model finetuning.
claim: 训练流程包括大规模预训练、在 CrossDocked 2020 上的监督微调，以及使用 REINFORCE 算法和外部对接软件奖励的强化学习微调 [S3.SS3.SSS1.p1][S3.SS3.SSS2.p2]。

quote: For pretraining, we use a large 3D molecular dataset proposed by the authors of the Uni-Mol model.
claim: 预训练使用 Uni-Mol 作者提出的大规模 3D 分子数据集，包含 208M 个构象、12M 个分子和 3.2M 个蛋白质口袋空间结构 [S4.p2]。

quote: For pretraining, we use a large 3D molecular dataset proposed by the authors of the Uni-Mol model.
claim: 口袋条件生成任务在 CrossDocked 数据集上微调，过滤后约有 27M 个口袋-配体对，覆盖 14k 分子与 3k 口袋的交叉组合，并留出 100 个口袋用于评估 [S4.p2]。

quote: For pretraining, we use a large 3D molecular dataset proposed by the authors of the Uni-Mol model.
claim: 3D 分子和 3D 构象生成任务在 GEOM-DRUGS 数据集上微调，该数据集包含 300k 分子的 27M 个构象 [S4.p2]。

quote: For pretraining, we use a large 3D molecular dataset proposed by the authors of the Uni-Mol model.
claim: 零样本构象生成评估使用 Platinum 数据集 [S4.p2]。

quote: EDM and MolDiff are task-specialized diffusion models for 3D molecule generation.
claim: 基线包括 EDM、MolDiff、XYZ-Transformer、Torsional Diffusion 和 Uni-Mol 等 [S4.SS1.p2]。

quote: the pretrained BindGPT model consistently outperforms the XYZ-TF baseline both without and with explicit hydrogens.
claim: 预训练的 BindGPT 在无显式氢和有显式氢两种设置下均持续优于 XYZ-TF 基线，并且是首个能在如此大规模下显式建模氢的模型 [S4.SS1.p3]。

quote: the pretrained BindGPT model consistently outperforms the XYZ-TF baseline both without and with explicit hydrogens.
claim: 在 GEOM-DRUGS 上微调后，BindGPT 在几乎所有分布评估指标上达到当前最佳性能，但在 Druglikeness 上未超过 MolDiff [S4.SS1.p3]。

quote: the pretrained BindGPT model consistently outperforms the XYZ-TF baseline both without and with explicit hydrogens.
claim: 在 Platinum 零样本构象生成评估中，Uni-Mol 未能泛化到该新数据集，而 BindGPT 在 RDKit 辅助下可匹配 Torsional Diffusion 的性能，无辅助时差距较小 [S4.SS1.p3]。

quote: the RL finetuned model can learn to search the space of binding molecules much more efficiently and significantly outperforms all the previous best baselines in terms of the binding energy.
claim: 在口袋条件分子生成任务中，经强化学习微调的 BindGPT-RL 在结合能上显著优于所有先前最佳基线 [S4.SS2.p3]。

quote: The study of stellar rotation periods has become increasingly important in our understanding of stellar evolution, activity cycles, and exoplanet detection.
claim: 论文旨在从光变曲线中测量恒星自转周期，因为自转周期研究对理解恒星演化、活动周以及系外行星探测日益重要 [S1.p1]。

quote: Classical methods for measuring rotation periods, such as Lomb-Scargle periodograms and autocorrelation functions, have been successful
claim: 经典方法（如 Lomb-Scargle 周期图与自相关函数）虽然成功，但耗时且难以应用于大型数据集，并且常常难以处理具有多个周期或演化黑子图案的复杂光变曲线 [S1.p2]。

quote: Classical methods for measuring rotation periods, such as Lomb-Scargle periodograms and autocorrelation functions, have been successful
claim: 作者希望用数据驱动方法自动并改进周期测量的准确度 [S1.p2]。

quote: The model utilizes a dual-branch architecture combining Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) and Transformer components to capture temporal and global data features.
claim: LightPred 是一个双分支深度学习模型，结合 LSTM 与 Transformer 组件以捕捉光变曲线中的时间与全局特征 [abstract]。

quote: The output of the model is four numbers: rotation period, inclination, period confidence score, and inclination confidence score.
claim: 模型输出四个数值：自转周期、倾角、周期置信度分数和倾角置信度分数 [S3.SS1.p4]。

quote: To train the model, we used a 2-step pipeline; First, we trained the model, without the prediction head, in a self-supervised fashion, with Kepler samples.
claim: 训练采用两步流程：先用 Kepler 样本进行自监督对比学习（SSL），再用模拟数据集进行基于模拟的监督学习（SBSL） [S4.SS2.p1]。

quote: To create a dataset for supervised training we used simulated light curves using Butterpy, a python package described in.
claim: 模拟光变曲线由 Butterpy 基于黑子模型生成 [S2.SS1.p1]。

quote: This was done on a dataset of 50000 simulated samples of 1000 days that were generated as explained in II.1 and II.2.
claim: 模拟数据集包含 50000 个样本，按 81%/9%/10% 划分为训练、验证和测试集 [S4.SS2.p1]。

quote: First, we downloaded the long cadence Kepler dataset Data Release 25.
claim: Kepler 数据使用长节奏 Data Release 25，经过预处理后用于 SSL 和推理的样本数为 130868 [S2.SS3.p1][S5.SS2.p1]。

quote: This left us with 130868 which serves both for the SSL step and the inference.
claim: Kepler 数据使用长节奏 Data Release 25，经过预处理后用于 SSL 和推理的样本数为 130868 [S2.SS3.p1][S5.SS2.p1]。

quote: this leaves us with 108096 samples.
claim: 推理时进一步筛选，最终得到 108096 个样本用于误差分析 [S5.SS2.SSS1.p1]。

quote: The trend of high confidence and low error, which can be easily seen in the figure, implies that the model was able to infer which samples are ”harder” for it to determine the stellar properties.
claim: 在模拟数据上，模型能够推断哪些样本更难确定恒星属性，表现为高置信度对应低误差 [S5.SS1.p3]。

quote: When considering the entire samples (left panel), our model has much lower error.
claim: 在 Kepler 数据上，与 ACF 相比，LightPred 在全部样本上误差更低，在 ACF 有效样本上误差略低，相对观测误差平均均为 11% [S5.SS2.SSS2.p2]。

quote: It can be seen that in general, more confident samples have better agreement.
claim: 模型预测与三个最大现有目录比较时，高置信度样本一致性更好，不一致点主要出现在半周期线和参考周期接近零的区域 [S5.SS2.SSS2.p4]。

quote: Additionally, we confirm tidal synchronization in eclipsing binaries with orbital periods shorter than 10 days.
claim: 作者确认了轨道周期短于 10 天的食双星中的潮汐同步现象 [abstract]。

quote: This procedure left us with 82771 reliable predictions.
claim: 最终目录包含 82771 个可靠预测 [S5.SS3.p2]。

quote: The suggested model implies an inherent degeneracy between inclination and spot location.
claim: 作者指出，模拟模型存在倾角与黑子位置之间的内在简并，且模型依赖先验：黑子分布在模型中影响很大 [S2.SS1.p1]。

quote: For longer periods the correlation is different which might be related to a drop in the activity for older stars.
claim: 对于周期大于 25 天的预测，模拟误差与观测误差的相关性不同，可能与较老恒星活动下降有关 [S5.SS2.SSS1.p2]。

quote: the former can be assigned to the limitations of the model with very fast rotators, exactly as we saw in Figure 9.
claim: 模型对非常快速旋转体（周期 < 3 天）存在局限 [S5.SS2.SSS4.p5]。

quote: It is possible that the observed light curve does not represent a single object but multiple objects.
